name: pits/ai_translate
description: AI Translate brings fast, flexible translation directly into the TYPO3 backend. Translate content elements and TCA records automatically using leading AI and translation services - including Google Translate, DeepL, OpenAI (ChatGPT), Gemini, Claude , Cohere and Mistral. Editors can auto-detect source language or select languages manually, making it a powerful auto translate and language translation solution for multilingual TYPO3 websites.
